PROFILE::stream
       Returns the value of a Stream profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::stream ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned Stream profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned Stream profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.
